Name: New Skin Tones - Content Patch Version
Author: Runzu87
Description:
[size=3]This is a Content Patcher update for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1231]New Skin Tones[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6866808]prettypinktardis[/url]. When I noticed how gorgeous the skin tone selection was, I took it upon myself to learn how to update it. Three hours later, I tested it in game and it worked wonderfully. I got permission from prettypinktardis to upload for everyone!

[/size]

[b][size=4]What this mod does:[/size][/b][size=4] Replace the selection of skin tones for the Farmer/Player.[/size]

[size=4][b]What this mod requires:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install this mod:[/b] [/size]

[u][size=4]Manually:[/size][/u][size=4] Download the zip file. Extract the folder '[CP] - New Skin Tones' using an extraction program. (WinZip, WinRar, or 7zip, 7zip has been my go-to for over a decade and it's free.) Take that folder and drop it into the Mods folder nested in the Stardew game folder.[/size]

[u][size=4]Mod Manager:[/size][/u][size=4] You can use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455][size=4]Stardrop[/size][/url][size=4]. Which I've positive experiences with (on Windows 10), since when updating/deleting mods it clears the entire folder. Info on its use should be on its page.[/size]

[b][size=4]Is this compatible with 'X' body mod?[/size][/b][size=4] I cannot guarantee that it will be, since I don't use body mods. I did try out Peach Body once and if you disable its skin tones option, it pulls from the default skins in game. Which is what [/size][i][size=4]this[/size][/i][size=4] mod replaces and could be a way it could work. You'll have to ask for support by the creators of those body mods.[/size]

[b][size=4]I have a visual glitch/bug:[/size][/b][size=4] It's likely another mod is causing it. This mod only patches the vanilla skins. There's no coding/function for anything else. If you have something that affects the farmer's body: Body mods, swimsuit mods, farmer animations, etc, it's likely that. I'm inexperienced, so support for those issues will be limited and likely directed elsewhere.[/size]

[size=4]Be sure to provide your [/size][url=https://smapi.io/log][size=4]SMAPI log[/size][/url][size=4] when asking about issues.[/size]

[size=4][b]How to change a farmer's skin in a saved game:[/b] You can use the Shrine of Illusions or you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734]Customize Anywhere[/url] to change your farmer's looks any time you want.

[/size][Edited title for clarity.]
[size=5][b]
Mods Used In Screenshots:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]Earthy Interface[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12421]Default Farmer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4757]CP Cuter Shoes for Female Farmer[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416]Custom Menu Background[/url]
